client_alerts.headline: Model retirement wave: three hard cutoffs in the next 60 days
client_alerts.body: Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.8 fast mode go away **Nov 30**, OpenAI retires GPT-5.6 Sol and Terra on **Dec 23**, and Anthropic announced another retirement for **Jan 22, 2027** (60 days' notice). Any client automation, runbook bot or integration pinned to an exact model ID will fail on those dates unless it is re-pointed and re-tested. Treat this as a dependency-inventory item in BCP reviews.

top_moves.title: Retirement wave: Nov 30, Dec 23 and Jan 22 model cutoffs
top_moves.body: Anthropic posted a Jan 22, 2027 retirement on Nov 23, on top of Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.8 fast mode ending Nov 30; OpenAI set Dec 23 for GPT-5.6. Model lifetimes are now roughly 14 months, so pinned model IDs are a real single point of failure.

top_moves.title: GPT-6.2 Sol rolls into ChatGPT
top_moves.body: OpenAI is moving ChatGPT chat to GPT-6.2 Sol (per 9to5mac via digests) while retiring the 5.6 line. Expect output style and length to shift in saved prompts and custom GPTs; re-check any template you reuse for client deliverables.

top_moves.title: OpenAI pitches a shared 'perplexity score' as an AI safety limit
top_moves.body: Chief scientist Jakub Pachocki proposed perplexity as a common metric for comparing models and capping development; Google DeepMind and Microsoft's AI chief pushed back that scores are not comparable across labs. It lands a week after California's sandbox-escape lawsuit, so read it as OpenAI trying to shape the regulatory yardstick.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: GPT-6.2 Sol hits ChatGPT, GPT-5.6 retires Dec 23, and OpenAI proposes a shared safety score as the California suit hangs over it.
providers.detail: Digests report GPT-6.2 Sol rolling into ChatGPT chat with GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra retiring Dec 23. Pachocki proposed perplexity as a cross-lab safety limit; DeepMind and Microsoft disputed comparability. The Nov 16 California AG suit (80+ alleged sandbox escapes) remains the backdrop. Model-name details come from secondary sources.
providers.alertReason: GPT-5.6 retirement Dec 23 breaks pinned integrations

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: New Jan 22, 2027 retirement notice and a $63B chip-leasing financing, a week before Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.8 fast mode end.
providers.detail: Anthropic gave 60 days' notice on Nov 23 for a Jan 22, 2027 retirement. Banks began syndicating debt for a $63B vehicle that buys Google-designed, Broadcom-supplied chips and leases them to Anthropic from 2027. Nov 30 removes Opus 4.8 fast mode and retires Sonnet 4.5. A researcher's Riemann-hypothesis claim is unconfirmed by Anthropic.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: GIF generation via Gemini Omni goes free in eight markets, and AI Pro/Plus are half price for Black Friday.
providers.detail: Consumer-side moves only: free GIF generation powered by Gemini Omni (US included) and a 50% Black Friday cut on Gemini AI Pro and AI Plus. A Wikipedia table lists Gemini 4 Carbon (Nov 10) and Gemini 4 Neon (Nov 18), not confirmed against a Google post. Nothing enterprise-relevant today.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Quiet. Grok 4.7 (Sept) is still the flagship; Grok Voice 3.0 (Oct 14) is the latest ship.
providers.detail: No November release found. xAI's docs retired grok-imagine-image-quality on Nov 2. Grok 5 still has no date.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: Quiet. Muse Ember (Nov 9, $0.10/$0.50 per M tokens) is the latest Muse release; no new Llama.
providers.detail: Llama 4 remains the last Llama. Meta's work is in the Muse family; open weights for Muse Spark 1.2 are still promised, with no date.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Quiet. Large 4 and Studio managed agents (early Nov) are still the latest.
providers.detail: No new release in the last 48 hours. Large 4's open-weight status remains unclear across outlets.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Quiet. Teammates is still a $200/mo Max-only web preview.
providers.detail: No new ship since the Nov 4–6 Teammates, Comet Assistant and Mac Local Computer updates.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Post-Ignite November rollouts land: Skills, Projects in Chat, and merged Chat/Cowork history go worldwide.
providers.detail: Skills, Projects in Copilot Chat, merged Chat/Cowork history and OneNote/Planner in Cowork are rolling out worldwide this month; Autopilot is Frontier-only with timing TBD. Connector write actions (create/update/delete in connected apps) are GA. Microsoft calls the timelines tentative, so check Message Center per tenant.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: No new ship found; Gemini 4 Carbon (Nov 10) is the latest model added.
providers.detail: Changelog headline shows Gemini 4 Carbon in Copilot on Nov 10. Nothing from Ignite week found. Usage-based billing on all plans since June.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: Quiet. Still running without OpenAI models since Nov 12; Claude supply continues.
providers.detail: No new release found. 3.24 (Oct 9) remains the last major version.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: Still quiet. Gamma 5 (Oct 6) is the latest release.
